task: Lobotomize deep-history memory and force generalization to fix Regime Overfitting (0.76 to 0.0115 decay). Execute a surgical reduction of the T-KAN receptive field to 32 ticks and heavily increase regularization via dropout and weight decay.

user_stories.title: Receptive Field & Regularization Surgery in T-KAN
user_stories.description: Change `self.dilation_rates` to `[1, 2, 4, 8, 16]`. Increase `nn.Dropout` in `_create_dilated_causal_layer` and `self.processing` to `0.5`. Increase `nn.Dropout` in `self.fc_head` to `0.6`. Update the `total_receptive_field` calculation in the `__main__` block. Ensure the forward pass still strictly returns `x[:, :, -901:]`.
acceptance_criteria: Dropout probabilities are increased to 0.5 and 0.6.
Model forward pass output shape remains exactly (batch, 901, 2).
user_stories.verification: python -c "import torch; from src.models.t_kan import TemporalKAN; model = TemporalKAN(); x = torch.randn(2, 1000, 40); y = model(x); assert y.shape == (2, 901, 2), f'Shape failed: {y.shape}'; assert model.dilation_rates == [1, 2, 4, 8, 16], 'Dilation failed'"
user_stories.why: To drastically reduce the receptive field to recent ticks only and heavily penalize network capacity to prevent memorization of the validation regime.

user_stories.title: Optimizer Penalty and Training Loop Constraints
user_stories.description: In `TrainingPipeline.__init__`, locate the `optim.AdamW` instantiation. Change `weight_decay` to `0.1` to heavily penalize memorization. Ensure `max_epochs` is set to `20`.
acceptance_criteria: The deploy() method remains completely unaltered.
user_stories.verification: python -c "lines = open('src/train.py').read(); assert 'weight_decay=0.1' in lines or 'weight_decay=1e-1' in lines, 'Weight decay not updated'"
user_stories.why: To enforce harsh L2 regularization (weight decay) forcing the model to learn only the most robust, generalized alpha signals instead of fitting noise.
